_meta.about: Every judge-facing number for LOKA Pay. The README, /judge, slides, video and Devpost read values from this file, and a test checks they match (task 4.2).
rules: Fill a value only from a real run, the code, or a primary source page. Never from memory or from the plan.
status is one of: pending, measured, computed, config, sourced, not_verified. A value stays null while status is pending.
Record how the value was produced in source and when in as_of (ISO 8601).
A number that is not in this file does not appear on any judge-facing surface.
